decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product in a growing market, the aloe vera facial care line likely has low carrying costs and its own page suggests stronger commitment and still-unresolved upside, so keeping the option is attractive.

The hyaluronic acid serum fits the firm's established capabilities and can be kept at relatively low incremental cost, but its more limited website prominence and the crowded serum segment raise the chance of later withdrawal somewhat.

The facial cleansing milk is a close extension of the existing range and likely inexpensive to continue offering, so a small firm with only a few new options would usually keep it while market acceptance becomes clearer.
